title: CPU Scheduling
subtitle: Trace how the OS dispatcher selects processes from ready queues, allocates CPU slices on a Gantt timeline, and balances waiting, turnaround, and response times.

fcfs.name: FCFS
fcfs.shortDesc: Non-preemptive FIFO queue ordered strictly by arrival time.

sjf.name: SJF
sjf.shortDesc: Non-preemptive selection of the ready process with the smallest CPU burst.

srtf.name: SRTF
srtf.shortDesc: Preemptive SJF that switches whenever a shorter burst arrives.

priority.name: Priority
priority.shortDesc: Dispatches the highest-priority ready process (smaller number = higher priority).

round-robin.name: Round Robin
round-robin.shortDesc: Preemptive time-sharing that rotates ready processes by a fixed time quantum q.

mlq.name: MLQ
mlq.shortDesc: Fixed foreground (Q0, RR) and background (Q1, FCFS) queues with strict priority.

mlfq.name: MLFQ
mlfq.shortDesc: Processes start in Q0 and demote across Q0 → Q1 → Q2 when they use their full quantum.

controls.mlfqQ2Note: Q2 runs non-preemptive FCFS for CPU-bound jobs.
controls.priorityHint: Lower integer indicates higher scheduling priority (1 is highest).

gantt.title: CPU Gantt chart
gantt.subtitle: Proportional execution timeline with exact dispatch boundaries
gantt.empty: Step forward or press Play to execute the first CPU slice.

queues.title: CPU & ready queues
queues.demotionHint: Full quantum used → demote to next lower queue

eval.title: Deterministic evaluation
eval.subtitle: Runs FCFS, SJF, SRTF, Priority, and Round Robin on your current process table to compare wait, turnaround, and response times.
eval.settingsNote: Evaluated with Round Robin q = {{quantum}} and Priority ({{mode}}).

errors.minProcesses: Keep at least 1 process in the workload.
errors.maxProcesses: Up to 8 processes are supported for clear visualization.
errors.invalidArrival: {{pid}}: arrival time must be an integer 0 or greater.
errors.invalidBurst: {{pid}}: CPU burst must be an integer between 1 and 100.
errors.invalidPriority: {{pid}}: priority must be a positive integer (1 or greater).
errors.invalidQuantum: Time quantum must be an integer between 1 and 30.
errors.invalidMlfqQuanta: Q0 and Q1 quanta must be integers between 1 and 30.
errors.applyFailed: Could not build schedule with the provided parameters.

steps.init: Initialized {{count}} processes in the scheduling workload.
steps.arrive: At t = {{time}}, {{pid}} arrives with burst {{burst}} and enters the ready queue.
steps.idle: CPU is idle from t = {{start}} to t = {{end}} waiting for the next arrival.
steps.dispatch: At t = {{time}}, dispatch {{pid}} to the CPU (remaining burst: {{remaining}}).
steps.dispatchPriority: At t = {{time}}, dispatch {{pid}} with highest priority ({{priority}}).
steps.dispatchQuantum: At t = {{time}}, dispatch {{pid}} for up to quantum q = {{quantum}} (remaining: {{remaining}}).
steps.runSlice: {{pid}} runs on the CPU from t = {{start}} to t = {{end}} (remaining: {{remaining}}).
steps.quantumExpire: At t = {{time}}, {{pid}} reaches its time quantum with {{remaining}} remaining and returns to the ready queue.
steps.demote: At t = {{time}}, {{pid}} exhausts its quantum in {{fromQueue}} and demotes to {{toQueue}} (remaining: {{remaining}}).
steps.done: Schedule complete: Avg Wait = {{avgWaiting}}, Avg Turnaround = {{avgTurnaround}}, Avg Response = {{avgResponse}}, CPU Util = {{cpuUtilization}}%.
